scholarships.name: Entrance Scholarship
scholarships.description: ICM is offering an entrance scholarship worth C$2,000 to new applicants who enroll in any 2026 or 2027 intake. Students who meet the terms and conditions will automatically be considered – no separate entrance scholarship application is required.

scholarships.name: Navitas Family Bursaries
scholarships.description: When two or more students from the same family study at a Navitas institution, the second student can apply for a Navitas Family Bursary.

scholarships.name: Susan Deane Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Susan Deane Memorial Scholarship program was established in honour of ICM’s first College Director and Principal, Susan Deane, and her significant contributions to both Navitas in Canada and the education sector more broadly in Manitoba.

scholarships.name: Academic Distinction Scholarship
scholarships.description: ICM is committed to helping you achieve your academic goals by offering scholarships to outstanding students. Each semester, ICM awards up to two students i n International Year One (UTP Stage II) with Academic Distinction Scholarships.

scholarships.name: Community Engagement Scholarship
scholarships.description: ICM is committed to helping you achieve your academic goals by offering scholarships to outstanding students. Each semester, ICM awards up to two students with Community Engagement Scholarships.
